svg.aria-label: 目标联系，不表示充分精化
svg.text: 独立于成立精化；箭头按联系类型解释，状态逐项标明。

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Aim to book flights at least one to one-and-a-half months ahead for a better price, ideall
y a couple of months ahead. → Obtain a good deal on flight bookings.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Use spare points or gift vouchers to help others save on their flights. → Book flights for
friends and family as well as for oneself.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Compare flight deals across multiple websites at intervals before booking. → Obtain a good
deal on flight bookings.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Search combinations of airports using country or region inputs instead of only the nearest
airport. → Explore alternative city or country pairs, nearby airports and dates to find s
uitable options.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Restrict departure and arrival times when connecting to another commitment. → Coordinate t
he flight itinerary with onward transport and lodging logistics to avoid long unproductive
waits.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Prefer international flight options balancing price and time rather than extremely long ch
eapest itineraries. → Find the best available travel alternative considering price, seatin
g and other benefits.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Compare the cheapest domestic options when the limited alternatives can be judged directly
. → Find the best available travel alternative considering price, seating and other benefi
ts.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Compare provider final prices, ratings and applicable discounts for a chosen itinerary. →
Find the best booking price for the selected itinerary across booking options.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Recheck available alternatives when an itinerary is unsuitable, while accepting the only f
easible urgent booking if necessary. → Find the best available travel alternative consider
ing price, seating and other benefits.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Prefer a reasonably priced flight arriving early enough to catch the last onward train and
get home that night. → Coordinate the flight itinerary with onward transport and lodging
logistics to avoid long unproductive waits.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Receive price-drop alerts for several acceptable routes when urgent travel becomes too exp
ensive. → Obtain a good deal on flight bookings.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Prefer to search revenue flights anonymously without logging in, except when a specific ne
ed forces login. → Avoid disclosing personal data or being tracked while researching fligh
ts.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Avoid sharing data with an additional party when an already-logged-in trusted-as-needed al
ternative can supply alerts. → Avoid disclosing personal data or being tracked while resea
rching flights.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Compare a broad combination of US and Indian airports, outbound and return date ranges and
service classes, including a separate points search. → Research many combinations of airp
orts, dates, travellers and service classes at the same time.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Show price comparisons with typical market prices when the traveller is unfamiliar with th
at market. → Find the best booking price for the selected itinerary across booking options

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Match flight timing to the schedule of the person being visited when relevant. → Find an i
tinerary whose connections and times fit the traveller's actual plans.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Prefer a flight time allowing a night's sleep, while accepting red-eye flights. → Find an
itinerary whose connections and times fit the traveller's actual plans.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Prefer stopover time of at least about 1.5 to 2 times the airport minimum connection time
to account for delays. → Coordinate the flight itinerary with onward transport and lodging
logistics to avoid long unproductive waits.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Ideally integrate an up-to-date record of the traveller's cards and lounge entitlements wi
th Skyscanner. → Check whether desired airport lounges will be open during stopovers.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Check lounge access policies, opening times and disruptions using the relevant card or pas
s issuer's source. → Check whether desired airport lounges will be open during stopovers.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Research many combinations of airports, dates, travellers and service classes at the same
time. → Reduce time and mental effort spent performing repeated flight research.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Access the information needed for booking in one place instead of consulting at least ten
to twelve sites. → Reduce time and mental effort spent performing repeated flight research

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
Reach the selected provider's itinerary page with flight details already populated. → Pay
the selected booking through a credit card after finalizing the itinerary and provider.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
Verify terminal and other journey logistics before booking. → Pay the selected booking thr
ough a credit card after finalizing the itinerary and provider.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Check whether desired airport lounges will be open during stopovers. → Visit different air
port lounges during travel when access and opening times permit.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Maintain global lounge access through Priority Pass. → Visit different airport lounges dur
ing travel when access and opening times permit.
